q: 1. The presence of more than ........ % of members in Nepal engineering council is considered as the fulfillment of minimum quorum.
explain: A meeting is valid only when more than half (50%) of the members are present; this is the minimum quorum.

q: 2. Which type of membership is categorized in NEC Act 2055?
options: Senior divisional engineer, superintending engineer and foreign engineer
Gazzetted 1st class, Gazzetted 2nd class, Gazzetted 3rd class
explain: NEC Act 2055 classifies registered engineers as general, professional and foreign engineers. The other options are government service designations.

q: 3. Which type of membership is not categorized in NEC act 2055?
explain: Senior divisional, superintending and chief engineer are civil service posts, not NEC membership categories, so all of them are not categorized.

q: 4. The tenure of registrar of Nepal engineering council is ........
explain: The book's answer key gives 4 years. Note that Q66 asks the same thing and the key gives 2 years there, so the book is inconsistent; verify against the NEC Act.

q: 5. The number of members in NEC are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the council has 21 members.

q: 6. Engineers shall not disclose, without ........ confidential information coming the business affairs of technical process of any present or former employer or public body on which they serve.
explain: Confidential information may be disclosed only with the consent of the employer or body concerned.

q: 7. The minimum qualification required for professional engineer is ........
explain: The answer key gives master in engineering. Qualification rules have been amended over time, so verify against the current NEC regulation.

q: 8. The minimum qualification required for foreign engineer is ........
options: bachelor in engineering and 5 years experience
bachelor in engineering and 10 years experience
master in engineering and 5 years experience
master in engineering and 5 years experience
explain: As per the answer key, a foreign engineer needs a bachelor's degree plus 10 years of experience. Options c and d are identical in the book.

q: 9. Workers aren't allowed to work continuously more than ........
explain: Under the Labor Act, a worker should not work continuously for more than 5 hours without a rest interval.

q: 10. The minimum and maximum number of members in the user's committee should be ........
explain: As per the answer key, a user's committee has a minimum of 9 and a maximum of 15 members.

q: 11. Which of the following is not concerned with the authority of engineers?
options: Express an opinion on engineering matter
explain: Divulging confidential matter is prohibited by the code of ethics. It is not an authority of engineers.

q: 12. Ethics as normative science needs codes of conduct and guidelines to maintain high level of standard of good behavior in the society. This is applicable to ........
explain: Codes of conduct apply to every profession, including law, medicine and engineering.

q: 13. Which is not concerned with the authority of engineers?
options: Express an opinion of engineering matter
explain: Disclosing confidential matter is unethical and not within an engineer's authority.

q: 14. Ethics is the science which deals with ........
explain: Ethics studies both what is right and what is wrong in professional conduct.

q: 15. Profession is defined as ........
options: types of service to needy people
explain: As per the answer key, all the given statements describe a profession.

q: 16. NEC regulation 2057, is effective from ........
explain: As per the answer key, the regulation came into effect on 2057/03/08 BS.

q: 17. The number of members in NEA are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the answer is 25.

q: 18. NEA was established in ........
explain: The Nepal Engineers' Association was established in 1962 AD, per the answer key.

q: 19. NEC was established in ........ BS.
explain: NEC was established under the Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055 BS.

q: 20. The contract will be awarded to ........
explain: Under public procurement rules, the contract goes to the bidder who is both substantially responsive and has the lowest evaluated bid.

q: 21. The authority to conduct the technical auditing in Nepal lies with ........
options: Office of Prime Minister and Council Of Ministers
explain: As per the answer key, the National Vigilance Center is the answer.

q: 22. Force majeure in a contract is of ........
options: occurrence of an act beyond the control of both contracting parties
preventing both parties to perform the respective obligation agreed
explain: Force majeure is an event beyond the control of both parties that prevents them from performing their obligations, so both statements apply.

q: 23. Generally during the evaluation of consulting firms to award the contract, the weightage will be ........
explain: Consultants are usually evaluated on quality and cost, with the technical score weighted much higher (80:20). Option d has a misprint (800%) in the book.

q: 24. Price adjustment in any contract will be done if price change exceeds by ........
explain: As per the answer key, price adjustment applies when the price change exceeds 10%.

q: 25. The project maintenance remains as a contractual obligation of the project contractor until the expiry of ........
explain: The contractor must repair defects until the defect liability period ends.

q: 26. Engineers shall act in such a manner as to uphold and enhance the honor, and dignity of the engineering profession and shall act with ........ for bribery, fraud and corruption.
explain: The code of ethics requires zero tolerance for bribery, fraud and corruption.

q: 27. Which of the following category of engineer is not mentioned in engineering council rule, 2057 for registration?
explain: The rule recognizes general, professional and foreign (non-Nepali) engineers. Chartered engineer is not a registration category.

q: 28. The type of contract when payment shall be made for actual work done at site is ........
explain: In a unit rate contract, payment is made on the measured quantities of work actually done at the agreed unit rates.

q: 29. As per Nepal engineering council act 2055, the tenure of the members of the council is ........
explain: As per the answer key, council members serve a 4-year tenure.

q: 30. The action or behavior of an individual in a particular society is concerned with right or wrong, good or bad is ........
explain: Ethics is the study of right and wrong, good and bad behavior in society.

q: 31. The registered engineers in Nepal engineering council should have to renew their registration in ........
explain: The answer key gives 'none of these', meaning the renewal interval is not one of the listed periods.

q: 32. In general, Nepal engineering council meeting per year should be held ........
explain: As per the answer key, the council meets four times a year.

q: 33. What is the provision in engineer council act and regulation in Nepal for the punishment if a person practices engineering work without registering into the Nepal engineering council?
options: Rs. 3000 fine or imprisonment of three months or both
Rs. 1000 fine or imprisonment of 1 month or both
explain: As per the answer key, the penalty is a Rs. 3000 fine or three months' imprisonment, or both.

q: 34. Engineers shall build their professional reputation on the ........ Of their services and shall not compete unfairly with others.
explain: The answer key gives 'basis'. Many versions of this code say 'merit', so double-check the wording against the NEC code of conduct.

q: 35. The penalty provision on any contract agreement is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the delay penalty (liquidated damage) is 0.05% of the contract price per day.

q: 36. Which of the document is prepared and submitted by contractor?
explain: As per the answer key, the contractor prepares and submits the quality assurance plan. The bid document and specifications are prepared by the employer.

q: 37. The maximum amount of advance payment (mobilization fund) permitted is ........ of contract.
explain: As per the answer key, the maximum mobilization advance is 20% of the contract amount.

q: 38. Which part of contract documents describes the process of performing any items of requirements?
explain: Specifications describe the materials, workmanship and method of performing each item of work.

q: 39. The term EPC stands for ........
explain: EPC means Engineering, Procurement and Construction, a turnkey contract where one contractor does all three.

q: 40. The price adjustment clause is essential for contract having duration greater than ........ months.
explain: As per the answer key, the clause is essential for contracts longer than 12 months.

q: 41. For the procurements of works upto 20 million by which method of procurement is ........
options: by direct labor or direct negotiation
explain: As per the answer key, works up to the threshold are procured by sealed quotation.

q: 42. The department head can extend the time up to ........ more than initial contract duration.
explain: As per the answer key, the department head can extend the time up to 25% of the initial duration.

q: 43. The contract adopted if all the items are easily measurable is ........
explain: When all items can be measured easily, an item rate contract is used and payment follows measured quantities.

q: 44. Consulting work worth more than 3 crores should be procured on the basis of ........
explain: As per the answer key, high-value consulting work is procured through international-level EOI followed by RFP.

q: 45. Performance security deposit for the contractor is equal to ........
explain: Performance security is 5% of the contract amount, per the answer key.

q: 46. The authority to conduct the monitoring of public procurement in Nepal lies in ........
explain: The Public Procurement Monitoring Office (PPMO) monitors public procurement.

q: 47. Contractor is liable to maintain the defects up to ........
explain: The contractor's liability to fix defects ends when the defect liability period ends.

q: 48. The dispute resolution method in any contract is ........
explain: Contracts provide a ladder of methods: amicable settlement, adjudication board and arbitration.

q: 49. The opening of bidding in the process of procurement is known as ........
explain: Inviting and opening bids in procurement is called tendering.

q: 50. The Nepalese engineers day is ........
explain: Engineers' Day in Nepal is observed on 3rd Shrawan.

q: 51. NEC categories the engineers into ........
explain: NEC registers engineers in 3 categories: general, professional and foreign.

q: 52. The registrar of NEC is nominated by ........
explain: The registrar is nominated by the Government of Nepal.

q: 53. According to labor act, maximum working hour for a labor per week should be ........
explain: The Labor Act limits regular work to 8 hours a day and 48 hours a week.

q: 54. The employer's have right to ........
explain: The employer may accept or reject bids, within the procurement rules.

q: 55. Who is the chairperson of construction material rate fixation committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer chairs the district rate fixation committee.

q: 56. For the supply of any goods as per agreement, who is responsible for the all taxed imposed by the GON ........
explain: The supplier bears all taxes imposed by the Government of Nepal under a supply agreement.

q: 57. Who is the chairperson of project co ordination committee?
explain: As per the answer key, the chairperson of the DDC chairs the project coordination committee.

q: 58. Professional code of conduct issued by Nepal engineering council ........
explain: As per the answer key, the NEC code of conduct has 8 articles.

q: 59. Civil service act Nepal, was effective from ........
explain: The Civil Service Act came into effect in 2049 BS.

q: 60. The duration of notice for sealed quotation is ........ days.
explain: As per the answer key, the sealed quotation notice period is 15 days.
